name: zp12
intro: A 12-bit sampler drum machine: the white keys are 16 pads, the black keys 11 loops; REC, then PLAY records a beat.

rows.what: Back to the faders: KNOB 1-4 = channel volumes 1-4.
KNOB 1-4 become faders 5-8; tap again for 1-4.
Pad pages; each tap the next: WAVE, SOUND, TRUNC, OUT, SENDS.
Mix effect pages: FILTER, CHORUS, DELAY, REVERB.
Loop pages: LOOP, TOOLS, SONG.
Setup pages: SETUP, CLICK, OUTPUT.
Pick the pad to edit (A1-D8) without playing it.
Tempo, half a BPM per click.
Play pads: keys 1-8 bank A, 9-16 bank B.
Banks C + D on the keys (OCT-: back to A + B).
Go to loop 1-11 (while playing: at the loop's end).
Swap the sample on the pad you hit last.
MULTI PITCH: last pad on all 27 keys; ARP again: off.
Mute channels 1-8 (keys 9-16: solo).
Tap tempo: tap it on the beat, twice or more.
On the faders: volume of channel 1 (KNOB 2-4: 2-4).
WAVE page: choose the pad's sample.
SOUND page: tune (KNOB 2 fine, 3 decay, 4 level).
TRUNC page: SPEED 33, lower and grittier (KNOB 3 reverse).
OUT page: pan; CUT and RESO filter pads 1-2 only.
Start / stop the loop.
Arm, count in 4 3 2 1, then record.
While playing: overdub on / off.
End the first take: an AUTO loop takes its length.
Hold 2 seconds: clear the loop.
Set / clear the last pad's 16 steps.
Step grid: next bar (OCT-: previous bar).
Erase that pad's hits (stopped: all at once).
Loop length: AUTO or 1-32 bars (KNOB 3 quantise, 4 swing).
Count-in: off, 1 bar or 2 bars.
Punch-in while held: roll 1/8, roll 1/16, reverse, tape stop.
Reverb throw while held (OCT+: echo throw).
DJ filter on the mix: left low-pass, right high-pass.
SENDS page: this pad's reverb (KNOB 3 delay, 2 chorus, 1 drive).
Save now (playing: at the stop); it also saves by itself.
Copy this loop into that loop.
Stopped: pick loop 1-16 (12-16 have no black key).
Undo the last clear, erase or copy (again: redo).
Stopped: factory reset; all loops and songs are gone.
USB rescue mode: reinstall from the web installer.

keys.label: Pads 1-8 of bank A (OCT+: bank C)
Pads 1-8 of bank B (OCT+: bank D)

tips: First beat: REC, PLAY, wait for 4 3 2 1, play white key 1 (kick) and 2 (snare), REC again.
Factory kit: A1 kick, A2 snare, A3 hat, A4 clap; B1-B4 the same, lower and grittier.
AUTO CORRECT (1/16) puts your hits on the grid; set it on SEQ > LOOP, KNOB 3.
A pad plays on the channel of its position: pad 3 of every bank is fader 3.
Turn TUNE, FINE, DECAY or CUT while recording: those hits keep the change.
Pages close by themselves after 12 s (GLO > SETUP > BACK changes that).
Sound dull or thin? FX > FILTER back to the centre (OFF); mute, solo and the DJ filter are not saved.
Songs: SEQ three times opens SONG; chain loops there and PLAY plays the song.
Own samples and backups: zp12.designburgapps.com/editor and /backup (Chrome or Edge, USB).
USB MIDI: notes 36-67 play pads A1-D8; Program Change 0-15 picks loop 1-16.
checked: sp_ui.c enum B_*: printed labels FX SEL ENV LFO EDIT GLO HOME SAVE ARP SEQ PLAY REC OCT- OCT+ (SEL is SLOOP's SCL); zp12.c encoders: 0 SELECT tempo (bpm10 +5 per detent = 0.5 BPM, 40-240), 1 ALGORITHM ui.sel, 2-5 KNOB 1-4, 6 PRESETS ui_preset -> wave_step.

sp_ui.c white_of/key_pad: 16 white keys, white 1-8 = pair*16 + 0..7 (bank A/C), 9-16 = +8..15 (bank B/D); key 12 (F4) = white 8; black keys counted 0..10 -> ui_loop (RQ_LOOP), 'LOOP n NEXT' while playing; zones use key indices 0..26 = F3..G5.

sp_ui.c button(): HOME -> PG_HOME; SEL toggles ui.shift (faders 5-8) and goes home; EDIT cycles WAVE..SENDS; FX cycles FILTER..REVERB; SEQ LOOP/TOOLS/SONG (tap < 350 ms in zp12.c); GLO SETUP/CLICK/OUTPUT (on release if no key used); ARP toggles ui.multi; ENV tap_tempo; PLAY RQ_PLAY/RQ_STOP; OCT+/OCT- ui.pair, or step bar while SEQ held; EDIT held + OCT- RQ_UNDO (again redo, sp_seq.c).

sp_ui.c key_down(): FX held -> punch names ROLL 1/8, ROLL 1/16, REVERSE, TAPE STOP (zp12.c pn.req, sp_punch.c); GLO held white 1-8 sp_mute, 9-16 sp_solo; SAVE held + black key RQ_COPY into that loop; SEQ held white key RQ_STEP for ui.sel; LFO held: erase (stopped RQ_WIPE at once, playing sq.erase in zp12.c); MULTI PITCH pad_hit_at(ui.sel, k-12).
sp_ui.c button(): FX held + OCT- 'REV THROW', OCT+ 'ECHO THROW' (zp12.c sp_thr_req while held).

sp_ui.c ui_holds(): REC acts on press; held 0.7 s + UI_HOLD_MS 1.3 s clears the loop and undoes the press; SAVE tapped = save_req; sp_seq.c RQ_REC: playing overdub on/off (DUB BAR waits for the next 1), stopped toggles rec_arm; sq_play: armed PLAY starts recording after cin_bars count-in; sq_stop_rec gives an AUTO segment its length.

sp_ui.c knob(): HOME faders; WAVE K1 sample; SOUND K1 TUNE -24..+12, K2 FINE, K3 DECAY, K4 LEVEL; TRUNC K3 DIR, K4 SPEED 45/33; OUT K1 CHOP, K2 PAN, K3/K4 CUT/RESO only channels 1-2; SENDS K1 DRIVE, K2 CHO, K3 DLY, K4 REV; FILTER K1 djf (negative LP, positive HP); LOOP K1 loop (stopped only), K2 BARS AUTO/1-32, K3 QUANT, K4 SWING; CLICK K1 CLICK, K2 COUNT OFF/1 BAR/2 BARS, K3 DUB; SETUP K4 RESET via again() twice within 1.5 s, stopped only -> zp12.c factory_req clears loops and songs.
zp12.c: ui.back = 1 -> UI_BACK_S 12 s; autosave when stopped, quiet and 3 s after a change; SAVE while playing -> 'SAVES AT STOP'; USB MIDI notes 36-67 -> pads, Program Change 0-15 -> ui_loop.
zp12.c fm1_cstart: recovery_key() -> bootguard_manual: OCT- alone at power-on -> recovery_main (USB rescue).
tools/gen_kit.py LAYOUT_A KICK SNARE HAT CLAP...; LAYOUT_B KICK-7 SNARE-7 OHAT CLAP-7 (TUNE -7 + SPEED 33 per web/cheatsheet.html).
Manual URL https://zp12.designburgapps.com/ returns 200 and contains id="cheatsheet".
unsure: CLAUDE.md says pages return after 6 s; the code's default is 12 s (ui.back = 1, UI_BACK_S) as Sven's cheat sheet says: followed the code.
CLAUDE.md says 'SEL held 5-8' and FX pages 'CHORUS, DELAY, REVERB'; the code makes SEL a toggle and FX starts with FILTER: followed the code (matches web/cheatsheet.html).

"do" items 'EDIT 3 times' / 'EDIT 4 times' / 'EDIT 5 times' go beyond the schema's verb list ('X twice'); counted from HOME (EDIT steps WAVE > SOUND > TRUNC > OUT > SENDS). Change the wording if make_fm1 rejects it.
B1-B4 'lower and grittier' from web/cheatsheet.html (TUNE -7 + SPEED 33) and gen_kit.py names; the per-pad tune values were not checked in the generated kit header.
Not covered on purpose: CHOP groups, SEQ > TOOLS clear/copy, song editing details, GLO > OUTPUT SMOOTH, click modes (left to the full manual).
